message: Vector Rebel 3.2.77: User Interface hides Master List; Daily Captain Checks support individually configured A/B/C shift tour calendars.
releaseNotes: User Interface presents Tour PPE, After Fire, PPE Form, Daily Captain Check, and Settings. The read-only Master List button remains Master-only; approved names still populate Captain Sets and PPE selection internally. Captain Sets now save a regular shift choice (A, B, or C); the department 48/96 C,C,A,A,B,B schedule anchored 2026-01-07 drives each shift-specific two-day audit tour calendar. Older saved sets remain C unless individually changed. Attendance rules are unchanged: Scout-confirmed work on any unit requires a tour check; two trusted full-day leave/deployment records can mark a completed tour OFF, and incomplete source evidence remains unknown. Captains can still enter explicit manual OFF exceptions after reviewing history. Temporary dates must match the selected regular shift. Read-only mode does not submit inspection records. Official status still requires field acceptance on Vector and authenticated Scout coverage. User interface and SCBA draft queues retain earlier version compatibility.
